{{Top|leg}}
Deflectors provided limited protection against all types of energy. The '''deflector Mark I''' [[droid shield]]s were used primarily to protect [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] from the particulate radiation they came into contact with in open [[Realspace/Legends|space]].

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be able to equip class 1 upgrades to be able to utilize this item.
